title: The drawing's CUT PIPE LENGTH table catches what the MTO hides
rule: جدول CUT PIPE LENGTH نقشه، تیزترین چک موجود است — چون qty در MTO گرد شده و معمولاً اضافه برای تنظیم میدانی دارد
note: Taken from a real drawing: 28"-CWR-10-930065A. CL 3336 and CUT 3211 are both printed on it, and the 125 mm between them is the flange hub. With the hub ignored the MTO check actually looked BETTER (0.04 m off instead of 0.09 m), because the BOM says 3.3 m. Only the cut length exposes it.

bom.description: Pipe, API 5L GR.B, LSAW, BE, SCH 10
Flange, ASTM A105N, Weld Neck, RF, 150#, ASME B16.47B
